name: pnpm-workspace

dependency.description:
Dependencies are specified with a simple hash of package name to version range.
The version range is a string which has one or more space-separated descriptors.
Dependencies can also be identified with a tarball or git URL.

catalog.description:
Define dependency version ranges as reusable constants,
for later reference in package.json files.
This (singular) field creates a catalog named default.

packages.description: Workspace package paths. Glob patterns are supported

description:
Our pnpm workspace is set up to include every package found under the `packages/*` and `components/*` directories, so any project placed in those folders will automatically become part of the workspace. By default we rely on a shared catalog that locks the versions of a few core dependencies: `lodash` is pinned to `^4.17.21` and `axios` to `^1.4.0`.

In addition to the default catalog we maintain two named catalogs for convenience. The **react** catalog defines both `react` and `react-dom` at version `^18.2.0`, ensuring a consistent React version across the codebase. The **testing** catalog provides the testing tooling, with `jest` fixed at `^29.5.0` and `ts-jest` at `^29.1.0`. These catalogs can be referenced in individual `package.json` files to keep the dependency versions centralized and up‑to‑date.
